Unit 8 — Boss Fight

Two weeks between Thanksgiving and Winter Break building the boss fight on your own: reusing elements already in the game (EnemyController, TurretController, projectiles, Platform, Spawner, StatManager) across brainstorming, prototyping, self-playtesting, friend playtesting, and revising.

Lessons

IDTitleWhat you build / learn
8.1Boss Design: Reuse & Brainstormthree divergent ideas remixing existing parts; pick one scope
8.2Boss Prototype I: Arena, Body & Healthgreybox arena + boss body using ChangeHealth() and phases
8.3Boss Prototype II: Player Attacks & Hitboxmelee (attackBox, KeyCode.E) & ranged (PlayerProjectile) hits
8.4Boss Prototype III: Patterns & Reused Hazardsturrets, platforms, spawners, Phase 2 waves & self-playtest
8.5Boss Playtest with Friends & Win/Lose Loopblind friend playtest notes + victory drop & StatManager.Die() reset
8.6Boss Revisions & Pre-Break Showcasetop revisions, verification re-test, freeze & showcase before break

Concepts this unit owns

Every semester pattern converges: state machines (Unit 4), cooldowns, events, the singleton — and the semester's real final: a playable game and a student who can explain it. CED: AAP-1/2/3 together, CRD-2 (design docs as code-adjacent artifacts).
